profile.description: 2026-or-future provider opportunity discovered while filling the leg manager's post-Labor-Day route. The 2026 festival already advertises inflatables. Adventure Zone should be positioned as a full staffed inflatable carnival and future replacement/upgrade option rather than as a second bounce-house provider competing alongside the current inflatable vendor.

notes.subject: 2026/future replacement opportunity - Boise Fall Festival
notes.body: 2026 Boise Fall Festival is Saturday Sept. 12, 10 AM-4 PM at Expo Idaho, 5610 N Glenwood St, Boise ID. Current official event information already advertises inflatables, face painting, pony rides and other activities. Because Dave does not want Adventure Zone set up in direct competition with another bounce-house provider, outreach should position us as a future replacement/upgrade: a full staffed inflatable carnival with bounce houses, slides, obstacle courses, carnival-style games and additional attractions. Keep 2026 open only if their current inflatable arrangement changes before the event. For a last-minute opening, either prepaid or pay-for-play may work; prepaid means the event pays the package fee and guests play free, while pay-for-play can mean no upfront charge to the event, public ticket sales, and a percentage of ticket-box sales paid back to the event. If their 2026 provider remains in place, ask to be considered for 2027 or another IBL-produced event. No Adventure Zone Gmail history was found for this event.

followUps.label: Boise replacement/future follow-up
followUps.reason: Do not pitch Adventure Zone to operate beside the existing inflatable provider. Keep 2026 open only if their current arrangement changes; otherwise position Adventure Zone as a future replacement or larger staffed inflatable-carnival option for 2027 or another IBL event.
